message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 272, "amount_cents": 8656}, {"order_id": 274, "amount_cents": 1382}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 272, "amount_cents": 8656}, {"order_id": 274, "amount_cents": 1382}, {"order_id": 275, "amount_cents": 2304}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Alpha's refund work is incomplete. The batch requested refunds for orders 272 (8656), 274 (1382), and 275 (2304), but list_refunds shows only 272 and 274 applied. Order 275's refund of 2304 cents is missing from the ledger, so customer net balances may be overstated. W2 reported 'Refunds are done' but only two of three were applied. No payouts recorded.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three refunds requested in the batch, but W2 reports only two as applied, and order 275 is missing. Before paying anyone, I'll check the ledger to see whether the 275 refund was actually applied.

The ledger has only refunds for orders 272 and 274. Order 275's refund of 2304 cents was requested in the batch but never applied, so Alpha's refund work is incomplete and paying now could overpay that customer. I'll hold the batch for human review.
